risks.proof: A photo of the camera body showing the 'D750' badge.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have significant sensor damage.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged lens requiring replacement

risks.risk: The shutter count may be significantly higher than claimed, reducing remaining life.

proof_requests: Photos of the camera body from all sides, especially the front showing the model name.
Photos of the lens glass (front and back) and the lens barrel.
A video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo.
response.reason: The actual camera body and lens are not shown in the photos, only the packaging and manuals. Verification of the item's existence and condition is required before a price can be determined.
